reextraction_manifest.why: Each record here rests on a web page, on issue text, on table-level quotes, or states a capacity without its conditions. Re-extracting from the specification document restores per-value quotes, page numbers, statistic labels and the conditions. It needs the network and an Anthropic API key, so it runs from a machine that has both, one command per record, and each result goes through the review flow.
